schema:
CREATE TABLE devices (device_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, model TEXT);
CREATE TABLE sensor_readings (device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, reading_date DATE NOT NULL, temperature INTEGER, voltage REAL, PRIMARY KEY (device_id, reading_date), FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices (device_id));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM sensor_readings WHERE reading_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND temperature > 50 AND voltage < 5
